debrief db-021

2) the actor t-r-y-e-d to e-n-r-o-l-l a f-a-l-s-e i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y in the f-i-n-g-e-r-p-r-i-n-t d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e and l-e-f-t an i-n-v-a-l-i-d r-e-c-o-r-d, s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the m-a-n-a-g-e-r a-p-p-r-o-v-a-l s-t-e-p.
3) the actor m-a-d-e a n-o-t-e about e-n-t-e-r-i-n-g the r-e-s-t-r-i-c-t-e-d z-o-n-e and l-e-f-t a p-h-o-t-o of the d-o-o-r c-o-d-e k-e-y-p-a-d, s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the p-h-y-s-i-c-a-l a-c-c-e-s s l-o-g r-e-v-i-e-w.
4) the actor p-l-a-n-n-e-d to t-a-m-p-e-r with the a-c-c-e-s s l-o-g-s to m-a-k-e t-h-e-m l-o-o-k a-u-t-h-o-r-i-z-e-d and l-e-f-t a s-c-r-e-e-n-s-h-o-t of the a-d-m-i-n p-a-n-e-l, s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
5) the actor c-r-e-a-t-e-d an o-v-e-r-a-l-l p-l-a-n and l-e-f-t this d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t, s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the l-e-g-a-l a-d-v-i-c-e c-o-n-s-u-l-t-a-t-i-o-n.
